title: 第一卷 第23章 林清薇第一卷 第24章 林动长老
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 晌午时分。
苏沐晴离去后。
林逸与李若雪在院中相对而坐，两人都是面色凝重。
“若雪姑娘，苏有福，赵猛，还有那个神秘黑衣人，要在我去沧海仙城的路上截杀我们！”
“我们该如何破局？”
林逸看着李若雪，满脸肃穆道。
现在的他，只是炼气五层修为。
只会种田，制符。
战力极低。
出去就是送死。
“一群跳梁小丑！”
“我李若雪走南闯北，不知道经历了多少次劫修偷袭，截杀，从未有人杀得了我！”
“现在，提前知道了他们的布局和谋划，他们就更加没有可能得手！”
李若雪面色冰冷，无比自信道。
作为一名剑修，炼气九层修为，战力极其强大。
筑基期之下，基本没人能杀得了她。
再加上她还有保命底牌，遇到三五个人同境界修者围攻，她也能逃得掉！
“若雪，你实力强大！”
“但你带着我这个累赘，会拖累你的！”
“要不，你自己回去购买青灵稻，我就不回去了？”
林逸商量问道。
他可不想因为这件事，导致自己丢了小命。
他有本命仙族灵树在，只要苟着，稳健一些，在云梦城这里，安稳打造家族，提升实力。
不出十年，他就能有望冲击筑基。
届时，再出城不迟！
现在的话，还是龟缩在云梦城管辖范围，更为稳妥一些。
“林逸，这次是族中一位金丹期长老林动，点名要见你，想要提前拉拢你！”
“毕竟，林氏本族，也是有着不同的派系！”
“等你参加族比的时候，你靠着五行催生术，表现出彩，再争夺你，就失去了先机！”
“我奉命而来，肯定要将你带过去见他！”
李若雪看着林逸略微苍老的面容，满脸坚决道。
“若雪，你这么做，不是让我去送死么？”
“真到了生死关头，你拍拍屁股走人了！”
“我不是死定了么？”
林逸顿时急了，连连摇头道。
不去沧海仙城，顶多是少赚点钱。
去了，很可能半路被人截杀，小命不保。
孰轻孰重，不言而喻。
“林逸，一味逃避没用的！”
“我辈修士，何惧一战？”
“你想不想一劳永逸，彻底解决这些隐患？”
李若雪看着林逸，战意澎湃道。
“若雪，你是剑修，天天打打杀杀！”
“我就是个种田的，拿什么去战？”
“难不成，我用稻谷砸死他们么？”
content_en:
At noon.
After Su Muqing left.
Lin Yi and Li Ruoxue sat opposite each other in the courtyard, both of them looking solemn.
"Miss Ruoxue, Su Youfu, Zhao Meng, and the mysterious man in black want to intercept and kill us on my way to Canghai Fairy City!"
"How do we break the situation?"
Lin Yi looked at Li Ruoxue and said solemnly.
Now he is only at the fifth level of Qi refining.
He only knows how to farm and make talismans.
Very low combat power.
To go out is to die.
"A bunch of clowns!"
"I, Li Ruoxue, have traveled all over the country, and I have experienced countless sneak attacks and interceptions, but no one has ever been able to kill me!"
"Now, knowing their layout and plan in advance, they will be even less likely to succeed!"
Li Ruoxue said with a cold face and extremely confident.
As a sword cultivator, with a ninth-level cultivation of Qi refining, his combat power is extremely powerful.
Under the foundation building stage, basically no one can kill her.
In addition, she has a life-saving trump card, and she can escape even if she is besieged by three or five cultivators of the same realm!
"Ruoxue, you are powerful!"
"But if you bring me as a burden, it will drag you down!"
"How about you go back and buy Qingling rice yourself, and I won't go back?"
Lin Yi asked after discussion.
He didn't want to lose his life because of this incident.
He has his own Immortal Clan Spirit Tree, so he only needs to hold on and be more steady, and here in Yunmeng City, he can build his family steadily and improve his strength.
In less than ten years, he can hope to hit the foundation.
By then, it’s not too late to leave the city!
For now, it would be safer to stay within the jurisdiction of Yunmeng City.
"Lin Yi, this time it's Lin Dong, an elder in the clan who is at the Golden Core stage. He wants to see you by name and wants to win over you in advance!"
"After all, the Lin family also has different factions!"
"When you participate in the clan competition, you rely on the Five Elements Rebirth Technique to perform brilliantly. If they compete with you again, you will lose the opportunity!"
"I came here under orders, and I will definitely take you over to see him!"
Li Ruoxue looked at Lin Yi's slightly older face and said firmly.
"Ruoxue, if you do this, aren't you asking me to die?"
"It's really a life-or-death situation, just slap your butt and leave!"
"Am I not dead?"
Lin Yi suddenly became anxious and shook his head repeatedly.
If you don’t go to Canghai Fairy City, you will at most make less money.
If you go there, you will probably be intercepted and killed on the way, and your life will be at risk.
Which one is more important is self-evident.
"Lin Yi, there's no use just running away!"
"As monks, why are we afraid of a battle?"
"Do you want to solve these hidden dangers once and for all?"
Li Ruoxue looked at Lin Yi and said with fighting spirit.
"Ruoxue, you are a sword cultivator and you fight and kill every day!"
"I'm just a farmer, why should I fight?"
"Could it be possible that I would kill them with rice?"
